placements.why: This envelope establishes a recurring, owned rehearsal cadence whose whole point is verifying that a claimed capability (rollback) actually works — the org's taxonomy names 'Proof' for exactly this kind of verification-of-capability work, and no strata node exists yet in this repo to hold it, so the first real content calling for it mints it now.
placements.title: Operational readiness must be demonstrated, not assumed
placements.theme: A capability claim only holds once it has been exercised and verified; unverified capability is treated as absent.

placements.title: Untested rollback capability does not count as capability
placements.theme: A rollback path only counts as real once it has been rehearsed on a recurring cadence with a named owner; an unrehearsed rollback must be treated as not existing.
placements.why: src-1 states the directional claim verbatim ('a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have'), and src-2/src-3 are the concrete cadence and ownership facts that operationalize that claim into a standing practice — all three feed one theme about capability requiring continuous proof, not a one-time fact each.
